TARGET_CONTRACT.terminal_truncation: official target builders; terminal transition reward-only

DECISION_RULE.YES: Median MC post-RTG EV and Pearson Corr each exceed N2 by at least 0.10; median MC RTG StdRatio is closer to 1; median MC next-episode pre-RTG EV and Corr each exceed N2 by at least 0.10.
DECISION_RULE.PARTIAL: Only current post-RTG fit or only next-episode pre-RTG generalization materially improves, or the full YES rule is not met despite a clear positive signal.
DECISION_RULE.NO: Neither current post-RTG fit nor next-episode pre-RTG generalization materially improves.
